question: G5: among accepted ICLR papers 2017-2025, do papers with longer titles (G5a, per +5 words) or more informative titles (G5b, title-abstract bge cosine, per SD within year) receive more or fewer Semantic Scholar citations than papers with similar content?
outcome: y = log(1 + Semantic Scholar citationCount, retrieved 2026-10-17); % difference = exp(b) - 1

G5b_informative.label: Title informativeness (title-abstract similarity, per SD within year)

frozen.label: Title informativeness (title-abstract similarity, per SD within year)

G5a_length_bins.model: y ~ 4 bin dummies + core.controls('G5a_length5') | year^topic50, SE clustered by topic50 (the linear G5a term is replaced by the bins)

G5a_length5.model: y ~ all 8 primary features + base controls | year^topic50

G5b_informative.model: y ~ all 8 primary features + base controls | year^topic50

G5a_length5.note: One model with the feature split by llm_topic plus an llm_topic main effect; 'difference' is the feature x llm_topic interaction, as a ratio of the two per-unit citation multipliers.

G5b_informative.note: One model with the feature split by llm_topic plus an llm_topic main effect; 'difference' is the feature x llm_topic interaction, as a ratio of the two per-unit citation multipliers.

difference_named_minus_not.model: G5b x G1_name; controls and year^topic50 FE interacted with G1_name (reproduces the two within-group estimates)

definition.lex_overlap: share of title content words (sklearn English stop words removed, >=3 chars) that also occur in the abstract
definition.topic_kw_share: share of title content words among the top 30 c-TF-IDF abstract words of the paper's topic50 cluster (cluster keywords include the paper's own abstract)

centrality.definition: cosine of the bge abstract (abs_central) or bge title (title_central) embedding to the mean bge abstract embedding of the paper's topic50 cluster (in-sample, own paper included), z within year

rule_signs.note: Holm is not applied: the alternative measure is not in the pre-registered family.

c_arxiv_and_match_rate.label: diagnostic (not pre-registered)

difference_no_arxiv_minus_arxiv.model: feature x no-arXiv; controls and year^topic50 FE interacted with arXiv status (as in G1/G4)
feature x no-arXiv; controls and year^topic50 FE interacted with arXiv status (as in G1/G4)

c_arxiv_and_match_rate.match_rate_note: terciles within year over all accepted papers 2017-25 (bge cosine / word count)

d_R1_scale.audit_note: The R1 pairing is shifted downward when there is no association (see g_audit.r1_null). The no-intercept 'pair_difference_slope_per_unit' absorbs that shift and is biased toward a negative slope (null means: g_audit.r1_null.<feature>.null.slope_no_intercept_null_mean_pct); use the null-corrected or with-intercept slopes in g_audit.r1_null instead.

G5a_length5.label: diagnostic (not pre-registered; added by the adversarial audit)
G5a_length5.doc:
Alternative explanations, as audit_g1g2.py:
    timing     Preprint exposure time. arXiv-id records only; months from first arXiv posting (from the id) to May of
               the ICLR year, entered as FE bins.
    code       Promotion / reuse: the abstract announces code or a URL.
    paper_type Method vs findings paper (abstract regexes, crude and unvalidated).
    tail       Superstars and zero-citation records: within-year citation percentile outcome; drop the top 5% per
               year; drop zero-citation records.
    retitling  Reverse causation through camera-ready retitling. The WP4 camera-ready audit (audit_pairs.csv, read
               only) gives the arXiv v1 title posted before the decision for 568 accepted 2023-25 papers in this
               sample. The feature is rebuilt on the v1 title (word count; bge v1-title-abstract cosine, z-scored with
               the camera-ready year mean and SD; template regexes from features.py) and used as the exposure on the
               same papers. Title-derived primary controls (G1, G5a) are rebuilt on the v1 title as well.
    combined   arXiv-id records; lead-month FE bins added to year^topic50; code + method + findings indicators.
